description: Batch load and upsert operations for ensureCatalog to eliminate N+1 query pattern
approach: Replace individual findUnique queries with batch findMany, then use createMany/updateMany for bulk operations. Pre-load all existing items in single query, process definitions in memory, batch write changes.

tasks.title: Batch load existing data items
tasks.description: Replace individual findUnique calls with single findMany to load all existing EconomicDataItem records at once

modification_points.description: Replace loop with individual queries to batch findMany

implementation: Extract all slugs from definitions array: const slugs = this.definitions.map(d => d.slug)

Execute single findMany query: const existingItems = await this.prisma.economicDataItem.findMany({ where: { slug: { in: slugs } }, include: { categories: { include: { category: true } }, fetchConfig: true } })
Create lookup Map for O(1) access: const existingItemMap = new Map(existingItems.map(item => [item.slug, item]))
Replace existingItem lookup in loop to use Map: const existingItem = existingItemMap.get(definition.slug)

unit: Test that findMany is called once with all slugs
Test that Map lookup returns correct items
Test that missing items return undefined from Map

criteria: Single findMany query replaces 40+ individual findUnique queries
Query count reduced from O(n) to O(1) for initial load
All existing functionality preserved (create new, update existing)
Module init time reduced by >50%
verification: Add query logging to verify single findMany call
Run existing tests to verify no regression

commit.message_template: perf(akshare): batch load existing items in ensureCatalog

tasks.title: Batch create new data items
tasks.description: Collect all new items and use createMany instead of individual create calls

modification_points.description: Replace individual create with batch collection and createMany

implementation: Create array to collect new items: const newItems: Prisma.EconomicDataItemCreateManyInput[] = []
In loop, instead of immediate create, push to array: newItems.push({ slug, displayName, ... })
After loop, execute batch create: await this.prisma.economicDataItem.createMany({ data: newItems, skipDuplicates: true })
Handle category relations separately since createMany doesn't support nested creates
Create category relations in batch after items created

unit: Test that createMany is called once with all new items
Test that skipDuplicates prevents errors on race conditions

criteria: Single createMany replaces N individual create calls
New items batch size matches definition count minus existing
Category relations created correctly for all new items
No duplicate key errors on concurrent module init
verification: Verify all new items have correct categories

commit.message_template: perf(akshare): batch create new items in ensureCatalog

tasks.title: Batch update existing data items
tasks.description: Collect all updates and use transaction with updateMany or raw SQL for batch updates

modification_points.description: Replace individual update calls with batch update collection

implementation: Create array to collect updates: const updates: Array<{id: string, data: Prisma.EconomicDataItemUpdateInput}> = []
In loop, instead of immediate update, push to array: updates.push({ id: existingItem.id, data: updates })
After loop, execute updates in transaction: await this.prisma.$transaction(updates.map(u => this.prisma.economicDataItem.update({ where: { id: u.id }, data: u.data })))
Consider raw SQL UPDATE with CASE for better performance if update count is high

unit: Test that transaction contains all updates
Test that updates are applied correctly

criteria: Updates batched in single transaction
Transaction rollback on any failure
Update count logged for monitoring
No partial updates on failure
